basics.name: Huayu Sha
basics.summary: Undergraduate researcher in Software Engineering at Fudan University, focusing on trustworthy LLM evaluation, medical benchmarks, novelty assessment, and scientific intelligence.

interests.name: Research Interests
keywords: Robust and fair evaluation of language models
Open-ended novelty assessment and scientific intelligence

publications.name: OpenNovelty: An LLM-powered Agentic System for Verifiable Scholarly Novelty Assessment
publications.summary: An evidence-grounded agentic system for scholarly novelty assessment with retrieval, comparison, and verifiable reporting.

publications.name: LLMEval-Fair: A Large-Scale Longitudinal Study on Robust and Fair Evaluation of Large Language Models
publications.summary: A dynamic evaluation framework for robust, contamination-resistant, and fair assessment of large language models, now accepted to ACL 2026 Main Conference.

publications.name: LLMEval-Med: A Real-world Clinical Benchmark for Medical LLMs with Physician Validation
